messages:
matt: Heads-up: console charts are super slow after today's deploy. Loading dashboards takes ~8-12s vs ~1.5s baseline.

deploy-bot: deployed web-frontend@1.4.9 (build 2026-02-15T16:05Z) to prod

sana: Is this across all orgs? I'm seeing a spike in bundle size and main chunk in the perf dashboard. @matt can you share repro steps?

matt: Only on console.production. Steps: open /dashboard/usage -> chart area blank for ~6s then paints. Network shows main.*.js = 2.6MB gzipped vs 1.1MB yesterday. Source map points to charting lib + render code.

li: Can you paste a Lighthouse trace and a devtools performance recording? I can run a lab trace too. Also share the main chunk filenames.

matt: quick snippet from devtools timeline: 
```
parse/compile: 4800ms
main.js (2.6MB) -> parse/compile heavy on charts module
charts-v2.js (1.1MB) -> evaluate + init 1200ms
```

maya: We're getting a few support tickets about slow dashboards. Is this related to the chart lib upgrade (5.1 -> 6.0) that went in yesterday? @corey you signed off on that, right?

corey: Yeah, I merged the chart upgrade + switched to an ESM entry. I expected tree-shaking to reduce weight but webpack chunking changed and ended up pulling more of the lib into main.

corey: Quick mitigation: change heavy charts to dynamic import and lazy-render behind a placeholder. Example: `const HeavyChart = lazy(() => import('./HeavyChart'))` and ensure SSR fallback is a skeleton.

sana: Two options: revert the chart upgrade (fast but disruptive), or hotfix by lazy-loading the chart (safer). Which is faster?

matt: I can put together a small PR to lazy-load + add skeleton + memoize props. Also instrument telemetry: emit `console.chart.render_ms` and `console.chart.first_paint` to monitor after deploy.

ops-bot: incident created: #1765204321-frontend-console-slow (severity: 3)

li: I'll spin up a canary routing rule and route 10% traffic to the previous build to compare p95. Also recommend capturing bundle-analysis report (source-map-explorer) to pinpoint what pulled into main.

corey: PR opened: #1765 - lazy-load charts + vendor split. CI showing eslint warnings, fixing now.

maya: :thumbsup: Please keep product updated on ETA and any user mitigations (e.g., show refreshed skeleton). Any page regressions elsewhere?

matt: Initial check: only dashboards with the new chart components. Will run A/B latency tests once PR is merged and push telemetry to datadog.

li: FYI ops: consider disabling source-map upload for that chunk during rollback to speed the revert. Also prepare rollback playbook in case the lazy-load fix doesn't cut p95 under 2s.

corey: I'll follow up with a chunking config change in webpack to force charts into a separate async chunk if lazy-load isn't enough.

maya: Thanks all. Keep incident notes concise in the thread and tag me on any user-facing messaging.
